views.text: In August 2026, Equity Mates acknowledged past scepticism about furniture as a growth story but credited Nick Scali’s execution, including its new UK presence, as evidence it delivered a compelling retail experience despite tough UK macro conditions.

views.text: In September 2022, Equity Mates noted Nick Scali’s revenue and profit were up that reporting season, indicating continued demand for its furniture even as consumers shifted away from discretionary categories.

views.text: In April 2022, Equity Mates described Nick Scali as a medium to up-market furniture retailer with about 60 outlets across Australia and New Zealand and a plan to grow to around 85, and noted the Plush acquisition broadened its offering.

episode.title: Expert: John Sevior - Airlie Funds Management

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In May 2025, a guest on Equity Mates said Nick Scali was one of only about 11 ASX companies to post after-tax ROIC above 15% every year for a decade and grew earnings roughly 14% annually, highlighting sustained profitability.

episode.title: How this investor stays focused when markets go wild - Will Granger | Airlie Funds Management

views.text: In October 2024, Equity Mates reported Nick Scali issued a profit warning and its shares fell 7%, flagging near-term profitability pressure for a founder-aligned retailer.

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates included Nick Scali among Australia’s dividend darlings over the past decade and highlighted its share price rising from about $2 to $15 since 2014, pointing to durable earnings supporting regular dividends.
